projectDescription: Clara is an AI Sales Development Representative that engages website visitors through face-to-face video, qualifies leads, runs personalized product demos, and books meetings 24/7 — without human SDRs.
keyFeatures: Face-to-face video AI engagement with website visitors
Real-time lead qualification through natural conversation
Live product demos with screen sharing and browser control
Automated meeting booking directly into sales team calendars
CRM sync (HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho) with full conversation context
24/7 availability across all time zones and major languages
Personalized product walkthroughs adapted to visitor industry and role
Objection handling using custom sales playbooks
SOC 2 Type II, GDPR, HIPAA, and ISO 27001 certified
Free plan with no credit card required; live on website in hours
publicApiSurface: Website embed script (deploy Clara via script tag)
CRM integrations: HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Brevo
Calendar integrations: Calendly, Google Calendar, Outlook
Custom avatar creation and training on product knowledge base
Buyer conversation analytics and pipeline reporting
